defect_observations: thm:p03-w03-p03-070-spectrum (annex lines 757-766) argues only for rational q outside XPL*_u; this suffices if Sp(A) is the set of rational discontinuities (def:p03-w03-p03-069-spectrum), otherwise irrational points need the one-line appeal to thm:p03-w03-p03-070-local-constancy(2).
Spencer's explosion example gives the numerator of 1/3+10^-6 as 10^6+1; the handbook corrects it to 10^6+3 (body lines 473-476).
Spencer calls T^-_alpha the limit of T_{alpha+eps}; the handbook warns that it is the limit from below (def:p03-w03-p03-070-side).
Tardos sufficiency: the source states it and on p.28 says the proof is in preparation; the handbook records it as unproved (def:p03-w03-p03-070-tardos). This is not counted as a gap.
